title: Qwen model family
answer: Qwen is Qwen's model line, with 53 versions listed in the OpenRouter catalog, the first released 2024-09-19 and the newest, Qwen3.8 Max Prime, on 2026-09-23. Some versions publish open weights and others are API only.
licence: Some open weights, some API only

family_reading.text: Qwen is a large family, with 53 versions in the catalog and a wide spread of tiers. Across the whole family, 36 of 53 versions support reasoning and 35 publish open weights, so both are common but not universal. Context windows run from 32768 to 1048576 tokens, and inputs can include audio, image, text and video, while output is text only. The newest versions show the range: cheap Flash and small open models at a few cents per million input tokens, and Max tiers at $2 to $4 input and $6 to $12 output. That suggests the family suits long-context work, multimodal input and reasoning tasks, with open weights available for self-hosting. Limits are the text-only output, the cost of the largest tiers, and the fact that not every version supports reasoning or open weights.
